name: Iver's Lamp
description: A Keeper's small lamp, a horn-paned box on a bail, cold now and gone silver all over, the wick white. Brother Iver Lusk held it out low over the Low Water every night for three months and listened, and with your ember beside him he let go of it in the air, and the fog made it hard. It holds his listening: the Choir round the rock, and one voice nearer than the rest, a woman's, tired, that nearly got a word out. Burn it, and he'll never have heard her. A Remnant, made on purpose.
